items.title: People at the Core
items.description: Our people are our greatest asset. We foster an environment where employees feel valued, supported and empowered to contribute to Aptus' success.

items.title: A Culture of Collaboration
items.description: We work with our clients as one team, building relationships grounded in mutual respect, trust and shared success.

items.title: A Workplace That Inspires
items.description: We cultivate an open, positive and inclusive workplace where employees are encouraged to share ideas, challenge conventions and bring creativity and innovation to their work.

items.title: Diverse Perspectives, Shared Purpose
items.description: Our diverse team brings together talent from 5–7+ nationalities, with experience across national, independent and international IT organizations.

items.title: Growing Local Talent
items.description: Developing Oman's national workforce remains a key priority. Our talented Omani professionals continue to grow their expertise, broaden their horizons and build meaningful careers within Oman's evolving technology landscape.

items.title: Performance That Is Recognized
items.description: We believe in recognizing contribution, encouraging professional growth and creating opportunities for our people to achieve both personal and organizational goals.

members.name: Rajesh Malaviya
members.bio: Rajesh Malaviya was responsible for guiding Oriental Oryx, (Aptus Infotech), through two decades of diversification and growth to finally emerge as one of the leaders in the IT & software industry in the Oman. With his inborn nature of wanting to know other people, his every interaction has been purposeful.

members.name: Mubin Mir
members.bio: A commerce graduate from University of Madras, an absolute team player, with a genuine commitment to the task with expertise in business development; core emphasis on creation of long-term value for an organization from customers, markets, and business relationships.

join.subheading: Build your career with a team that builds what's next.
paragraphs: At Aptus Infotech, we believe great technology starts with great people. We bring together diverse talent, technical expertise and fresh ideas to deliver solutions that make a difference for our clients.
Whether you are an experienced professional or looking to take the next step in your career, Aptus offers an environment where you can learn, contribute, innovate and grow.
